answer: Proposed relay gate: each ID sends 1 GB of encrypted nebula images, tundra maps or voyage logs in the same daily audit minute. Validators assign disjoint ranges, check hashes and count received bytes; falling short delists that ID. Caches and parallel servers help but cannot reuse delivery credit. Hardware is reusable capital; power/transit are recurring expenses; no stake. Honest meters are assumed; spare prepaid bandwidth may mean zero marginal fees. Audits show sampled capacity, not uptime or unique owners. Ten IDs require 10 x 1 = 10 GB/min aggregate egress.
